title: shadow-validated-precision-safemode-and-auto-revert
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Ship a production-ready rollout pattern for FP8/INT8 quantized model variants that validates accuracy in a shadow lane and performs an automated safe-mode revert when quality regressions are detected. This ticket covers: 1) calibration artifacts and per-run metadata; 2) shadow inference path and comparator service; 3) automated fallback/orchestrator that switches traffic and records audit logs; 4) acceptance criteria and a test matrix for metric thresholds. Motivation: recent experiments show non-deterministic accuracy regressions for certain prompt families after aggressive per-layer FP8 calibrations. We need an operational guard that prevents customer-facing regressions without blocking our ability to ship quantized variants.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow path runs for 5% of sampled production requests with zero customer-visible latency degradation (measurement window: 99th latency increase < 5ms)
Comparator computes per-request metrics (token-level log-prob delta, embedding cosine distance, hallucination flag) and aggregates rolling windows of 1k requests per prompt slice
Automatic revert triggers when: A) embedding distance degrades > 0.12 AND B) mean token log-prob delta decreases by > 0.25 for the same slice over two consecutive windows
On revert, traffic is routed back to float16 baseline within 30s and an audit event + incident ticket is created automatically
Calibration artifacts (scale tables, example batches, seed, dataset hash) are stored in the calibration bucket with versioned metadata and linked to the model tag
End-to-end integration tests exercise the comparator and fallback loop in staging and produce deterministic fail/recover traces
steps: Design comparator schema and metric set (embedding, token-likelihood, safety labels, custom prompt-specific checks)
Implement shadow router: duplicate a sampled subset of requests to quantized inference instances (no traffic splitling for responses)
Extend calibration harness to emit standardized artifacts and per-layer quant stats (store in GCS path and registry)
Build comparator service that ingests pairs (baseline, quantized) and computes per-request diffs + aggregated alerts
Add fallback orchestrator that listens for comparator alerts and executes a staged revert policy with notif + audit logging
Create RBAC and audit hooks for private deployments (VPC key access and on-prem KMS recording)
Write end-to-end integration tests and run canary experiments in staging cluster
Document operator runbook and add console dashboard tiles for slice-level regressions

implementation_notes: Comparator must be idempotent and tolerant of tokenization differences; canonicalize whitespace and use same tokenizer and seed for both branches
Calibration harness will include a small stratified validation set with labeled prompt slices (retrieval, instruction, code, dialog) to measure slice-level regressions
Use embedding cosine distance and delta in expected log-likelihood as primary signals; weight judgments by token-importance (end-of-sequence tokens discounted)
Fallback orchestrator should prefer incremental traffic steering to capacity-compatible float variants before full revert for minimal blast radius
Audit events must be emitted to central eventstream with model_tag, calibration_artifact_uri, comparator_window_id, and operator_id
